title: Citizen Promaster Eco-Drive Diver BN0150-28E
description_en: Citizen's Eco-Drive technology converts any light — sunlight or artificial — into energy, so this watch never needs a battery change. ISO 6425 dive watch certified, 200m water resistance, anti-reflective sapphire crystal. A workhorse built for the deep.
description_ja: シチズンのEco-Drive技術で光を電力に変換。電池交換不要。ISO 6425ダイバーズウォッチ認定・200m防水・サファイアクリスタル搭載。光があれば止まらない信頼の一本。
